description: Mid-game (about moves 8-16) where play is concentrated in columns 2-3 (opponent stacked in column 3, often also column 0) while columns 4-6 and column 1 are nearly empty, especially of opponent stones; strongest when the opponent's last move went to an edge column (0 or 6). A last move into column 1 or 2, early or late game, or stones on the right side switch it off. Diffuse; no single tactical concept.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.02 on 4 positions.
notes: Layer-1 unit behaves like a diffuse sum over (player, column) move counts plus the last move. Shape-only rules F1 0.26; hand-weighted move-count score with last-move and ply terms F1 0.33 (P0.32 R0.35), graded version AUROC 0.72; simple rule (ply 8-16, right side <=3 stones, cols 2+3 >=5, last move not col 1/2) F1 0.33. FPs look like hits. Simulation share ~0.04. Steering: no effect. Synth 2.71 beats dev max 2.42. Score call 1 was an accidental duplicate.
